expected_level_description: You can: - manage a records service and its procedures - audit record-keeping and train staff
You can: - run the retention and disposal programme for a records service - advise teams on retention for new types of record, including digital ones - audit compliance with retention schedules
You can: - log, acknowledge, and track requests to meet time limits - gather and redact information, and draft responses for review - check the identity and authority of the person asking
You can: - collect and organise evidence for the annual self-assessment - carry out simple audits, such as access or record-keeping audits - track improvement actions
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - define data quality rules and measures - work with data providers to fix the root causes of poor quality
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - maintain plans, risk and issue logs, and reports - run project meetings and track actions - manage a small, well-defined project with support
